name: raven-monitor
description: Local-first AI agent monitoring tool - Web version

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -n tsc,node -c "yellow,blue" "cd backend && npm run build:watch" "cd backend && npm run dev"
scripts.build:all: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
